answer: Random peer audit blocks bulk fake identities. A new identity posts a bond of twice its 30-day earnings, locked for 20 epochs, and must pass a random audit before it can bridge into paid work. Auditors check work on each terrace, and disputed cases wait in a lagoon of held bonds until cleared. A failed audit burns the bond. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds and faces 100 audits, while an honest agent pays once and keeps rewards undiluted.
